strings.custom_command_usage_msg:
yt-dlp is a powerful command-line tool for downloading videos. Omicron makes it easier to use yt-dlp by providing an intuitive GUI, presets for common commands, and other additional features.

For advanced usage of yt-dlp, Omicron allows you to create, save and execute custom command templates directly, just like in a terminal.

When using custom commands, most of the GUI options and features would be disabled.
